text:
alex: Heads-up — scheduling a DRY-RUN full AZ drain for eu-west-2 next Wed 02:00 UTC. Purpose: validate inter-region failover, routing, and SLO signal sanity. Planned window 20m. https://redwood.infra/maint/1779216789 :warning:

maria: Added to my calendar. Which services are in scope?

alex: In-scope: inference pool (text-gen + chat), embeddings, routing control-plane writers. Excluded: control-plane read-only APIs, telemetry collectors.

jon: We'll need an annotated incident doc and muted noise rules. I'll prep a runbook patch and mute noisy alerts for the window.

sre-bot: maintenance created: maint-1779216789 | start: 2026-03-11T02:00:00Z | duration: 20m | owner: alex

sam: Can we shorten to 10m? the last full drain caused a 12m tail once.

alex: We need 20m to let KV caches flush and KV-sync mirror complete. If prechecks pass we can shorten on the fly.

maria: What are abort criteria? explicit thresholds?

alex: Abort if any of: 
- global 5m error rate > 2% for the inference service
- p95 latency increase > 400ms above baseline for >5m
- sustained streaming disconnects > 1% for >3m
If abort, re-enable zone and reroute traffic back.

sam: Can you paste the exact alert queries so we don't mismatch?

alex: Sure — quick copies (promql):
```
# error rate by service
sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\",status=~\"5..\"}[5m])) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job=\"inference\"}[5m])) > 0.02

# p95 latency
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"inference\"}[5m])) by (le)) > (baseline_p95 + 0.4)
```

dave: Loadgen plan: ramp 0->300 TPS over 3m, hold 15m, then ramp down. Mix: 70% text-gen, 20% chat, 10% embeddings. Will tag runs with `dryrun/1779216789`.

alex: Nice. Operator steps (brief):
1) run precheck: `rjctl zone-health --zone=eu-west-2 --check=mirror,kv,peers`
2) start drain (dry-run flag): `rjctl drain --zone=eu-west-2 --dry-run --reason=\"dry-run failover test\"`
3) watch dashboards + alerts.
4) if abort -> `rjctl drain-abort --zone=eu-west-2`

maria: Who's the exec oncall for this window?

jon: I'll be primary oncall, alex backup. Product-ops will send the customer banner.

product-ops: Sending PMs and banner to affected customers now. We'll include expected window and contact link.

alex: Quick checklist for everyone:
- jon: runbook + mute rules (done by EOD today)
- dave: loadgen schedule + tags
- sam: precheck script validation
- maria: customer comms review

sam: Precheck script already at `scripts/zone_precheck.sh` — will run nightly until the dry-run.

sre-bot: Reminder in 24h: maint-1779216789 will start in 24h.

maria: Small ask — log an SLO note: this is a planned maintenance but may briefly affect SLOs. We should record the window for post-mortem and SLO accounting.

alex: Agreed. We'll tag all metrics with `maintenance:dryrun_eu2` and include in the postmortem. After-run: 1 hr post-check to validate no lingering regressions.

dave: I'll post loadgen run summary + raw traces to the thread after the run.

sam: thumbs-up here :thumbsup:

alex: Thanks all. If you see anything unexpected during prechecks ping @jon and @alex immediately. Otherwise we'll proceed as planned. :white_check_mark:
